description: Preview and remove one stored credential block from a local/global .env file. Preview-first: the default call projects the removal and returns a plan_handle; call again with execute=true and that handle to delete.

execute.description: Persist the reviewed removal (default false = preview only, writes nothing).

plan_handle.description: Plan handle returned by the reviewed preview. Required for execute=true.

target.description: Stored target from list_stored_credentials, e.g. primary or connection_1.

name: remove_stored_credentials
title: Remove Stored Credentials
